title: Whole Edge-Clamped and Wall-Equipped Service Bench
description: One complete static professional service workcorner, one scene and zero new independent models. Four unchanged complete qualified models are retained: the whole open worktable, the whole paired-clamp carriage and guarded tracing-disk machine on its left tabletop, the entire table-edge bench vise mounted at the right front edge, and the entire cycle-service tool panel including all original tools, keepers and both rear cleats on a separate finite back wall. The vise upper bearing partially contacts the real top face and its whole lower pressure pad contacts the real table underside; it is not placed on the floor or buried in the tabletop. All four full machine ground pads rest on the tabletop. Both entire wall-panel rear cleats meet the vertical wall. This tabletop, underside-edge and separate vertical mounting relationship differs from a table with loose sample tools or a raised metrology plate; it does not count replacement tools as new models. Only a finite floor and back wall are scene-only geometry. Original mesh attributes, indices, full PBR dictionaries, per-face assignments and internal node hierarchy are preserved without scaling, trimming or baking. Static art only: no key pattern, copying, cutting, tool operation, human access compliance, load capacity, stability or safety guarantee. Rigging, animation and interaction are not made and outside this scene.
